entities.name: Mikhail Mikeshin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mikhail Osipovich Mikeshin was a Russian painter and sculpture enthusiast who regularly worked for the Romanov family and designed a number of outdoor statues in the major cities of the Russian Empire.
